formulas.formula: Say I do somewhere beautiful, with every peso and dollar in view.
Setup: names, destination, wedding date, the local currency and today's exchange rate.
Budget: every vendor. Pick USD or Local for each line; everything is converted to dollars for the totals.
Guests: party size, RSVP, rooms needed, whether they booked in your block and when they arrive.
Room Block: your hotel contract. See if you'll hit the minimum before the cut-off.
Timeline: tasks dated back from the wedding. Payments: what's due next.
Type how many local units equal 1 USD (for example 17.5 pesos). Update it now and then.
Many resorts charge for unbooked rooms. Watch the shortfall number.
Some couples do the legal part at home and the ceremony abroad.
Most destination guests cover travel. Thank them with a welcome bag.
Cheers to forever, wherever you are.
